ActiveInput.description: The unfinished input chain's text; GET context is its only carrier.
ActiveInput.title: ActiveInput

AdvanceSummary.description: Active input chain; input text itself is only readable via GET context.
AdvanceSummary.title: AdvanceSummary

BaselineView.description: Frozen baseline the point work applies time and candidates onto.
BaselineView.title: BaselineView

ContextResponse.description: GET /worlds/{worldId}/context response; no requestId, no tokens.
ContextResponse.title: ContextResponse

ControlState.description:
Controller position, pause and narration gate.

phase is the next computation position; there is no await_narration or
paused phase anymore — waiting is the gate, pausing is the flag. canCompute
is a transaction-time server snapshot, never a client-side invariant: the
next write can still fail on lease or gate grounds.
ControlState.title: ControlState

ErrorResponse.description:
Uniform error envelope; world/control/work snapshots are optional and
required by controlRequired codes.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

GateView.description:
Narration gate without its claim token.

status=pending carries the current claim generation and issue/expiry instants;
status=none carries nulls. Generation 0 never exists: the creation and commit
transactions issue generation=1 directly.
GateView.title: GateView

HeadSummary.description: Latest committed point; the state its digest projects.
HeadSummary.title: HeadSummary

LeaseSummary.description: Active advance lease without its token; fenceEpoch is always positive.
LeaseSummary.title: LeaseSummary

PendingGroupView.description: Model goals only; admission is recomputed from rolls and eligibility.
PendingGroupView.title: PendingGroupView

PointWorkView.description:
Read-only projection of one point's uncommitted work.

phase is the point-scoped work position (select_actor/build_group/
settle_group); round-scoped positions live on ControlState. The browser
must never send this view back as authoritative state.
PointWorkView.title: PointWorkView

PreviewPointRequest.description: Stateless recompute; no requestId, never enters the idempotency table.
PreviewPointRequest.title: PreviewPointRequest

RoundSummary.description: Active round; conclusion is set once the round reaches complete.
RoundSummary.title: RoundSummary

SettledUnitView.description: One staged settlement unit; outer order is significant and never sorted.
SettledUnitView.title: SettledUnitView

SettlementCandidates.description: Six ordered state stages; no natural-language action history.
SettlementCandidates.title: SettlementCandidates

SettlementGroup.description:
One ordered settlement unit.

groupId=None marks the pure time-scan unit of an action-less point: it may
not invent movement, appearance or actors. A named group is an action unit
and requires actors. Outer order in commit requests is significant; member
ordering inside sets is not.
SettlementGroup.title: SettlementGroup

WorkingProgress.description: Uncommitted working cursor and sets; committed progress lives in the head.
WorkingProgress.title: WorkingProgress

WorldContext.description: Where the world stands: head, input chain, round, time, lease, pointers.
WorldContext.title: WorldContext

WorldState.description: The exact hash projection; contains no execution or narration metadata.
WorldState.title: WorldState

title: Jity world protocol v2 (S1 candidate; wire only)
